title: The Christmas House 2: Deck Those Halls
overview: The Mitchell brothers compete to see who can create the best Christmas House.

title: The Christmas House
overview: Working through some difficult decisions, Mitchell family matriarch Phylis and patriarch Bill, have summoned their two grown sons – TV stars Mike Mitchell and Brandon Mitchell – home for the holidays. It is their hope that bringing the family together to recreate the Christmas house, will help them find resolution and make a memorable holiday for the entire family and community.
